description: Database layer: triage and write the review doc stub, write all pgTAP tests (expected red), then apply three corrective migrations — 0018 (feed schema fix), 0019 (sync_push hardening with IDOR fix, allow-list enforcement, terminal-only idempotency, config-driven generic upsert, task monotonicity, vet request state-machine, numeric server_version, revokes), and 0020 (list_available_vets hardening). All pgTAP tests must be green after this FEAT.
steps: 1. Read context.json for project orientation. Read supabase/migrations/0001–0017 in order to understand the full schema history (already done by planner; key findings are in the plan). Read supabase/tests/database/sync_push_test.sql for the existing test structure.

2. Create docs/feed-module-review.md with: (a) findings table listing all F-01 through F-20 issues from the plan, each with ID/severity/layer/root-cause/status=OPEN, (b) contract mismatch table for feed_items, feed_transactions, batches, vaccination_tasks, vet_assistance_requests comparing columns across Supabase tables vs sync_table_config writable_columns vs sync_push upsert branches vs Dart mapper toPayload keys, (c) decisions section recording canonical names (consumption not usage; signed adjustment; farm_id immutable; no coalesce for nullable fields).

3. Run `flutter pub get && dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs && flutter analyze && flutter test` and capture output. If supabase is available: `supabase db reset && supabase test db`. Record pass/fail counts in the review doc.

4. Create supabase/tests/database/feed_schema_test.sql: pgTAP tests for feed kinds, quantity constraints, unit_cost, same-farm references via sync_push, and index existence. Use begin/plan(N)/finish()/rollback structure. Tests must be RED before migration 0018.

5. Create supabase/tests/database/sync_push_security_test.sql: pgTAP tests for cross-farm upsert, payload filtering, reference-table rejection, idempotency (FK retryable not stored; duplicate preserves original status), per-op isolation, config-driven upsert (feed_items feed_type/unit/reorder_level/deleted_at persist), task monotonicity (done_on/done_by/product_used/notes protected), vet request transitions, farm field clearing, role checks. Tests must be RED before migration 0019.

6. Create supabase/tests/database/list_available_vets_test.sql: pgTAP tests for farm-membership check, no raw coordinates in response, verified/active/opted-in filter, result limit, anon rejection. Tests must be RED before migration 0020.

7. Create supabase/migrations/0018_feed_schema_fix.sql with header comment. Content: UPDATE feed_transactions SET kind='consumption' WHERE kind='usage'; DROP+ADD feed_transactions_kind_check with canonical set (no usage); DROP+ADD quantity constraint split by kind (purchase/consumption/wastage > 0, adjustment <> 0, both NOT VALID); DROP+ADD unit_cost_check (>= 0, NOT VALID); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS feed_items_farm_deleted_idx and feed_transactions_item_occurred_idx (partial, where deleted_at is null); UPDATE sync_table_config for feed_items to kind=mutable with correct writable_columns. Run supabase db reset; confirm feed_schema_test.sql passes.

8. Create supabase/migrations/0019_sync_push_hardening.sql with header comment. Replace sync_push with a version that implements ALL of: (a) stored-farm auth check before every non-farms upsert (load farm_id from existing row, reject with forbidden if mismatch); (b) farm_id immutable — remove farm_id from every do-update-set clause in batches, vaccination_tasks, mortality_records, vet_assistance_requests; (c) WHERE <table>.farm_id = excluded.farm_id guard on all mutable upserts, reject v_existing IS NULL as forbidden; (d) reference-table rejection using sync_table_config kind='reference' — reject with forbidden, non-retryable; (e) retryable FK failure: do NOT insert into sync_ops_applied; (f) duplicate branch: return original status + duplicate:true flag, do NOT overwrite stored result with 'duplicate'; (g) config-driven generic upsert for feed_items and any unlisted table using writable_columns from sync_table_config (build SET clause dynamically, exclude id/farm_id/created_at on update); (h) task monotonicity: wrap done_on/done_by/product_used/notes in same rank CASE as status; (i) vet request state-machine: normalise pending_sync->submitted; reject farmer push of accepted/in_progress/completed/declined; reject cancel when existing status is accepted/in_progress/completed; (j) delete op: load stored farm_id first, return not_found if row missing; (k) no sqlerrm in response (remove 'message' key from when-others handler); (l) server_version returned as bigint not text; (m) remove dead second farms branch; (n) same-farm reference check for feed_transactions (feed_item_id.farm_id = tx.farm_id; batch_id.farm_id = tx.farm_id when present); REVOKE execute from public, anon; GRANT to authenticated. Run supabase db reset; confirm sync_push_security_test.sql passes.

9. Create supabase/migrations/0020_vet_rpc_hardening.sql with header comment. Add is_verified/is_active/opted_in columns to vet_profiles (NOT NULL DEFAULT false/true/true). Replace list_available_vets with version that: (a) adds p_limit int default 50 parameter with clamp 1-100; (b) requires is_farm_member(p_farm_id) when p_farm_id is not null, raises forbidden otherwise; (c) removes latitude/longitude from returned JSON; (d) adds WHERE v.is_verified=true AND v.is_active=true AND v.opted_in=true; (e) applies LIMIT. REVOKE execute from public, anon; GRANT to authenticated. Run supabase db reset; confirm list_available_vets_test.sql passes.
10. Run full pgTAP suite: supabase db reset && supabase test db. All tests must pass. Update docs/feed-module-review.md findings table to mark F-01 through F-11, F-15, F-18, F-19, F-20 as FIXED.
11. Commit: 'feat(db): feed schema fix, sync_push hardening, vet RPC hardening (0018-0020)'
acceptance_criteria: supabase db reset succeeds from scratch (migrations 0001-0020 apply cleanly)
supabase test db: all tests in feed_schema_test.sql, sync_push_security_test.sql, list_available_vets_test.sql pass
supabase test db: existing sync_push_test.sql (6 smoke tests) still passes
cross-farm IDOR test: user of farm B cannot overwrite a row belonging to farm A
writable-columns test: server_version/created_by/deleted_group_id in payload do not change server values
feed_items update via sync_push persists feed_type, unit, reorder_level, deleted_at
task monotonicity: lower-rank status update does not erase done_on/done_by/product_used/notes
vet request: pending_sync normalised to submitted; farmer cannot push accepted/in_progress/completed
list_available_vets response contains no latitude/longitude fields; only verified+active+opted-in vets returned
anon cannot execute sync_push or list_available_vets
docs/feed-module-review.md created with findings table and contract mismatch table
findings: Supabase CLI was unavailable (Docker not present); supabase db reset and supabase test db were skipped. All migrations and pgTAP tests were written based on static analysis of migrations 0001-0017 and the Dart codebase. flutter analyze exits 0 (41 pre-existing info-level warnings, none introduced by this change). Key decisions: (1) 'usage' migrated to 'consumption' in 0018 before the kind constraint is replaced; (2) quantity constraint split: adjustment allows <0 and >0 but not 0, all other kinds >0; (3) sync_push 0019 uses config-driven generic upsert for feed_items and any unlisted mutable table, building the SET clause dynamically from sync_table_config.writable_columns; (4) FK-retryable errors are intentionally NOT stored in sync_ops_applied so retries are treated as new ops; (5) duplicate branch returns original stored result + duplicate:true flag without overwriting status; (6) sqlerrm removed from when-others handler; (7) server_version returned as bigint cast, not text; (8) list_available_vets 0020 adds is_verified/is_active/opted_in columns to vet_profiles (NOT NULL DEFAULT false/true/true), adds p_limit int default 50 clamped 1-100, requires is_farm_member when p_farm_id is not null, removes latitude/longitude from returned JSON, and grants execute only to authenticated.
